requirements: R1: The backend service must start successfully, establish a valid database connection, and execute Flyway migrations without crashing.
R2: The backup service must successfully locate and execute its backup script upon startup without file not found errors.

slices.title: Repair runtime initialization for backend and backup services
slices.jtbd: When implementing the runtime initialization repair for this epic, I want the backend database connection properties and backup container script paths configured correctly, so that all services start reliably without initialization crashes or missing file errors.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the backend container, When it starts, Then it connects to the database and initializes Flyway without crashing.
Given the backup container, When it starts, Then the backup script is found and executes successfully.
Given the mandatory QA coverage, When the services are launched locally, Then all containers start successfully and remain healthy.
